verdict.rationale: The ADK GitHub README describes a graph-based Workflow Runtime for composing deterministic execution flows. It supports routing (branching), fan-out/fan-in (parallel steps), loops, retry, dynamic nodes and nested workflows, and the docs confirm graph-based workflows that orchestrate multiple agents with explicit execution paths. Missing for 10: in-depth workflow API docs or code examples showing branching, loop and parallel constructs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
